name: Build Debian Packages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_deb.yml
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-deb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Free disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: false
          dotnet: false
          haskell: false
          large-packages: false
          docker-images: false
          preinstalled-runtimes: false
          tool-cache: false
          swap-storage: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git patchelf fakeroot dpkg-dev

      - name: Cache APT packages
        uses: awalsh128/cache-apt-pkgs-action@latest
        with:
          packages: build-essential cmake git patchelf fakeroot dpkg-dev
          version: 1
          execute_install_scripts: true
          empty_packages_behavior: fail
          refresh: true
          debug: false
          add-repository: ""

      - name: Build GPAC (abi-16.4)
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/gpac/gpac.git gpac
          cd gpac
          git checkout tags/abi-16.4
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/libgpac
          cp /usr/local/lib/libgpac.so.0.0.0 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/libgpac/libgpac.so.0.0.0

      - name: Build ccextractor basic
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/basic
          cd build/basic
          cmake ../../ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DBUILD_OCR=ON -DBUILD_FFMPEG=OFF
          make -j$(nproc)
          make install DESTDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic

      - name: Set rpath for basic binary
        run: |
          patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib' $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/usr/local/bin/ccextractor

      - name: Build ccextractor hardsubx
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/hardsubx
          cd build/hardsubx
          cmake ../../ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DBUILD_OCR=ON -DBUILD_FFMPEG=ON
          make -j$(nproc)
          make install DESTDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx

      - name: Set rpath for hardsubx binary
        run: |
          patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib' $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/usr/local/bin/ccextractor

      - name: Prepare Debian package basic
        run: |
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/DEBIAN
          cat > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/DEBIAN/control <<EOF
Package: ccextractor-basic
Version: 1.0.0
Section: utils
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: CCExtractor <dev@ccextractor.org>
Description: CCExtractor basic package with OCR support
EOF
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/usr/local/lib
          cp $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/libgpac/libgpac.so.0.0.0 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/usr/local/lib/
          patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN' $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic/usr/local/lib/libgpac.so.0.0.0

      - name: Prepare Debian package hardsubx
        run: |
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/DEBIAN
          cat > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/DEBIAN/control <<EOF
Package: ccextractor-hardsubx
Version: 1.0.0
Section: utils
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: CCExtractor <dev@ccextractor.org>
Description: CCExtractor hardsubx package with FFmpeg support
EOF
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/usr/local/lib
          cp $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/libgpac/libgpac.so.0.0.0 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/usr/local/lib/
          patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN' $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx/usr/local/lib/libgpac.so.0.0.0

      - name: Build .deb basic
        run: |
          fakeroot dpkg-deb --build $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-basic $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-basic_1.0.0_amd64.deb

      - name: Build .deb hardsubx
        run: |
          fakeroot dpkg-deb --build $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package-hardsubx $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-hardsubx_1.0.0_amd64.deb

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deb-packages
          path: |
            $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-basic_1.0.0_amd64.deb
            $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-hardsubx_1.0.0_amd64.deb

      - name: Upload to release
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: |
            $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-basic_1.0.0_amd64.deb
            $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ccextractor-hardsubx_1.0.0_amd64.deb
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
